title: Project config (.ai-toolkit/project.json)
description: One repo's settings for agent-factory skills. Every field is optional: what's missing is detected from git and the working tree.

trunk.description: The canonical trunk branch. Detected from origin/HEAD when absent.

packageManager.description: Free-form: pnpm, npm, yarn, bun, uv, cargo, go, maven, gradle, none, …

prTemplate.description: Repo-relative PR template path, or null for none.

host.description: Free-form git host, e.g. github.com or a GitHub Enterprise host.

upstream.description: Canonical owner/repo when origin is a fork.

planHome.description: Repo-relative directory for plans. Default: plans

writeAllowed.description: false makes every posting, pushing or ticket-moving skill ask first. Default: true

root.description: Path relative to this repo's root. Default: ../<name>

access.description: read needs no permission; write lets a skill change the neighbor without asking. Default: read

tracker.description: Name of an installed tracker adapter skill, or null for none.

mining.description: toolkit-pr-mining settings for this repo: reviewer cohort, bot policy, path scope.

cohort.description: Bare reviewer logins whose comments count as human evidence.

loginSuffix.description: Appended to a cohort login in GitHub search queries when the host's account names carry one. Output keeps bare logins.

mine.description: Run the bot discovery axis by default. Default: false

minOccurrenceUnits.description: Evidence bar for a pattern only bots raised. Default: 5

minVerified.description: Occurrences that must be checked against the code. Default: 2

include.description: Repo-relative directory prefixes in scope. Empty or absent: the whole repo.

exclude.description: Prefixes removed from scope. Wins over include.

pathlessBodies.description: Keep a review body with no path only on a PR wholly in scope (default) or never.

commentMarker.description: What toolkit-pr-comment adds to every comment it posts. null or {"mode":"off"} adds nothing.

text.description: The marker tag. The script writes <!-- <text> {metadata json} --> as the body's first line (text and banner modes).

banner.description: Visible line prepended to the body (banner mode): one string, or one per kind.
